exposure: Immediate postpartum intrauterine contraceptive device (PPIUCD) insertion
cohort: The study included women presenting to antenatal OPD who were counseled about family planning and encouraged to opt for copper-T insertion immediately after delivery.
finding: Antenatal counseling was more efficient in encouraging IUCD uptake than postpartum counseling, with age, education, and economic class influencing acceptance, and a statistically significant number of women (94.35%) continuing IUCD use for at least 12 months.
